picks.headline: Qualcomm's new flagship chips go big on 5GHz speeds, agentic AI, and, of course, gaming
picks.rationale: Official Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 launch framed around on-device agentic AI -- the silicon behind next year's Android flagships; distinct from the earlier pre-launch NPU leak; chosen over CNET/XDA duplicates.
picks.excerpt: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 family reaches 5GHz and doubles down on agentic AI, while the new Extreme tier adds serious gaming and camera upgrades.

picks.headline: Rabbit's new AI agent doesn't need an R1 to run
picks.rationale: Rabbit moves OS3 off its own hardware to a cross-platform agent -- a telling pivot for dedicated AI gadgets; Verge taken over the WIRED duplicate to keep WIRED free for Vonder.
picks.excerpt: Rabbit still isn't giving up on AI hardware, though.

picks.headline: Apple has reportedly 'postponed' AI pendant product
picks.rationale: Bloomberg-sourced report that Apple shelved its camera-equipped AI pin/pendant -- a signal on the AI-wearable category; 9to5Mac chosen over MacRumors (on-topic pin image, MacRumors already ran today's Apple rumor).
picks.excerpt: A new Bloomberg report today from Mark Gurman says a forthcoming AI product—the rumored wearable pendant—has been put on hold.

picks.headline: Viture's Vonder Glasses Are Meant to Map Your Mind
picks.rationale: New product: camera-free, display-free AI glasses built around private voice capture -- a fresh design answer to the smart-glasses privacy problem; WIRED over the Tom's Guide duplicate.
picks.excerpt: No cameras? No problem. Viture's first display-free smart glasses have bone-conduction microphones to privately record your daily musings.

picks.headline: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
picks.rationale: Actionable security finding: a ClickFix-style attack can fully hijack Meta's top-charting Muse agent -- the single strongest of the three Muse angles (CNET Amazon block and WIRED privacy review dropped).
picks.excerpt: A simple ClickFix attack is only one way to completely hijack the new agent.
